(25,"L&P (IMPORTANT): At an expected EV of about $220 million, a flat 1.75% fee is above market; for sell-side mandates in the $150-$300 million range, fees typically fall around 1.0%-1.5%, with fees above 1.5% for deals over $200 million generally above market.
